verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops let you describe a recurring job in plain language and choose whether it runs on a schedule or in response to an event. Triggers cover workspace activity such as changes to initiatives, projects and cycles. Documented examples include auto-updating launch plans and docs and posting Slack explanations when a target date changes. missing for 10: in-depth reference docs on schedule configuration (frequency, timing options, limits), independent or hands-on corroboration that Loops work as described.
